article.title: Roger Congleton’s notes on the credit crisis
article.excerpt: They are a good outline to many events behind the current crisis; many of you have been writing to me and asking for background reading. Another of my colleagues, David Levy, just published this short piece (with Sandra Peart) on the ratings agencies and the idea of experts.
